title: 第1章 长官我真没疯第2章 审讯
slug: 魔法我钢铁洪流直接平推
lines: 义父们今天辛苦了，大脑什么的放这里歇歇，卡文了我随机炫两颗尝尝咸淡补补。
2027年，大夏，北方贝尔市。
室外温度，55摄氏度。
明明太阳落山了，扭曲的热浪依旧把柏油马路烤成了软趴趴的太妃糖。
林默顶着这能把人蒸熟的温度，大口喘着粗气的冲向一座被挖空山体而建的军事基地大门。
他额头上的汗刚冒出来就被蒸干，只留下一层白花花的盐渍。
但他的眼神，却是异常坚定。
“站住！这里是军事管理区，立即停止靠近！”
全副武装的哨兵走出岗亭，厉声大喝，枪口已经端平，黑洞洞的枪管直指来人。
自从蓝星自转减速，磁场出问题，各种地震火山喷发和海啸等自然问题频发不穷，大气层逸散更是导致全球气候走向末日！
短短一坤年时间，为了活命被逼疯的人太多了。
天天都有人妄图冲击军区，抢夺地下城的生存名额。
哨兵们早就有了条件反射，任何不明人员靠近，先当威胁处理。
“别开枪！我有重要的事要汇报！”
林默立即停下脚步，大声喊道：
“我发现了一个异世界！一个能救命的新世界！”
哨兵的表情纹丝不动。
这种话他听得耳朵都长茧了。
上礼拜还有个大爷冲过来说自己是玉皇大帝转世，要召唤天兵天将拯救苍生呢。
“最后警告！立即后退，否则后果自负！”
林默咬了咬牙，心中焦急如焚。
他知道自己这番话在别人耳朵里听起来有多荒谬，但他手里握着的东西，足以证明一切！
他太想证明自己了。
脚下下意识又往前迈了一步。
一声巨大的枪响响彻四方。
哨兵毫不犹豫地朝天鸣枪警告，随后枪口重新锁定林默的脑袋，眼神冰冷得像是在看一个死人。
林默被吓的猛地一哆嗦，冷汗刷地就下来了。
对方真敢开枪！
他立马僵在原地，举起双手，连大气都不敢喘一口。
枪声惊动了军区内部。
伴随着杂乱的脚步声和金属碰撞的响动，几名荷枪实弹的士兵簇拥着一位校级军官，快步从大门里跑了出来。
“怎么回事？”军官眉头紧锁，目光如刀。
“报告！”哨兵立正敬礼，声音洪亮，
“发现不明人员不听劝阻靠近防线，已鸣枪警告！”
军官上下打量了林默一眼。
看着他那一身皱巴巴还带着酸臭味的t恤，怎么看，都是个普通得不能再普通的小老百姓。
他眉头皱起道：
“姓名？把身份证慢慢掏出来。”
林默小心翼翼地用两根手指捏着身份卡从兜里掏出来，递了过去。
“长官，我叫林默。我没疯，我真的发现了一个异世界！”
content_en:
The adoptive fathers have worked hard today. Let's rest our brains here. If I'm stuck, I'll randomly give you two pills to taste and taste the saltiness and tonic.
——
2027, Daxia, Northern Bell City.
Outdoor temperature, 55 degrees Celsius.
Even though the sun has set, the twisted heat wave still bakes the asphalt road into soft toffee.
Lin Mo braved the temperature that could steam people to death, panting heavily and rushed towards the gate of a military base built by hollowing out the mountain.
The sweat on his forehead was evaporated as soon as it appeared, leaving only a layer of white salt stains.
But his eyes were extremely firm.
"Stop! This is a military management area, stop approaching immediately!"
The heavily armed sentry walked out of the guard box and shouted loudly. The muzzle of the gun was leveled, and the black barrel was pointed directly at the visitor.
Since the blue star's rotation has slowed down, there have been problems with the magnetic field, various natural problems such as earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and tsunamis have occurred frequently. The escape of the atmosphere has even led to the end of the global climate!
In just one year, too many people have been driven crazy trying to survive.
Every day, people try to attack the military area and seize the living quota in the underground city.
The sentries have long had a conditioned reflex to treat any unknown person approaching as a threat.
"Don't shoot! I have something important to report!"
Lin Mo immediately stopped and shouted:
"I discovered a different world! A new world that can save lives!"
The sentry's expression remained motionless.
His ears grew calluses hearing such words.
Last week, an old man rushed over and said that he was the reincarnation of the Jade Emperor and wanted to summon heavenly soldiers and generals to save the common people.
"Final warning! Retreat immediately or bear the consequences!"
Lin Mo gritted his teeth, feeling anxious.
He knew how ridiculous his words sounded to others, but what he held in his hand was enough to prove everything!
He wanted to prove himself so much.
He subconsciously took another step forward.
"Bang!"
A huge gunshot resounded in all directions.
The sentry fired a warning shot into the air without hesitation, and then locked the gun on Lin Mo's head again, his eyes as cold as looking at a dead man.
Lin Mo was so frightened that he trembled violently and broke out in cold sweat.
The other party really dared to shoot!
He immediately froze on the spot, raising his hands, not even daring to take a breath.
The sound of gunfire alarmed the interior of the military zone.
Accompanied by the sound of chaotic footsteps and the sound of metal collision, several soldiers with live ammunition surrounded a school-level officer and quickly ran out of the gate.
"What's going on?" The officer frowned, his eyes like daggers.
"Report!" The sentry stood at attention and saluted with a loud voice.
"It was discovered that unknown persons were approaching the defense line despite being dissuaded, and a warning shot was fired!"
The officer looked Lin Mo up and down.
Looking at his wrinkled T-shirt with a sour smell, no matter how you look at it, he is an extremely ordinary little commoner.
He frowned and said:
"Name? Slowly take out your ID card."
Lin Mo carefully took out the ID card from his pocket with two fingers and handed it over.
"Sir, my name is Lin Mo. I'm not crazy, I really discovered a different world!"
